rules.title: Prohibition of Anti-Competitive Automated Rent Price-Fixing – landlord use ban
rules.requirement: The proposed ordinance would make it unlawful for a landlord to use an algorithmic device (software or product that uses algorithms to calculate nonpublic competitor data to advise on or recommend rental rates or occupancy levels) to set rental rates or occupancy levels for residential rental property. Each month a violation continues, and each residential rental property on which the device is used, is a separate violation.
rules.coverage_text: Landlords of residential rental property in the City of San Diego using algorithmic devices that perform calculations of nonpublic competitor data to advise or recommend rental rates or occupancy levels.
rules.exemptions: Algorithmic device does not include (a) software or products used to publish reports on rental rates or occupancy levels from aggregated historical nonpublic competitor data more than 90 days old, or from information available to the general public, that do not recommend rental rates or occupancy levels for future leases or renewals; or (b) software or products used to establish rental rates or income limits in accordance with local, state, or federal affordable housing program guidelines.
rules.penalty: A tenant may seek injunctive relief, damages, or civil penalties of up to $1,000 per violation in a civil action against a landlord; a prevailing tenant recovers costs and reasonable attorney's fees. Each month a violation continues and each residential rental property is a separate violation.
rules.quoted_span: (b) It is unlawful for a landlord to use an algorithmic device to set rental rates or occupancy levels for residential rental property.
rules.effective_date_phrase: This Ordinance will take effect and be in force on the thirtieth day from and after its final passage.
rules.interaction_text: The remedies under section 98.1104 are cumulative and are in addition to any other remedies in this Division or at law, statute, or ordinance.

rules.title: Prohibition of Anti-Competitive Automated Rent Price-Fixing – sale and licensing ban
rules.requirement: The proposed ordinance would make it unlawful for any person to sell, license, or otherwise provide an algorithmic device to a landlord.
rules.coverage_text: Any person selling, licensing, or providing algorithmic devices to landlords for residential rental property in the City of San Diego.
rules.exemptions: Algorithmic device does not include (a) software or products used to publish reports on rental rates or occupancy levels from aggregated historical nonpublic competitor data more than 90 days old, or from information available to the general public, that do not recommend rental rates or occupancy levels for future leases or renewals; or (b) software or products used to establish rental rates or income limits in accordance with local, state, or federal affordable housing program guidelines.
rules.quoted_span: (a) It is unlawful for a person to sell, license, or otherwise provide an algorithmic device to a landlord.
rules.effective_date_phrase: This Ordinance will take effect and be in force on the thirtieth day from and after its final passage.
